## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck:ui`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build:ui` (when UI or packaging inputs changed)
- [ ] I checked the diff for secrets, local paths, databases, logs, and generated artifacts.

## Review notes

- [ ] Documentation/configuration was updated when behaviour or commands changed.
- [ ] Security, provider permissions, and human review gates remain fail-closed.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots or a short description of the tested flow.
